name: 3D Printing
description: Are you interested in 3D Printing? Become a member and enjoy 24/7 access to our 3D printers and a community of experienced makers!

benefits.title: Learning from Experienced Members
benefits.description: Learn from and troubleshoot with experienced members in our 3D printing community, getting guidance on design, settings, and best practices.

benefits.title: High-Quality Printers
benefits.description: Access easy-to-use, high-quality printers that are maintained by community members to ensure reliable performance for your projects.

benefits.title: Heat-set Insert Tools
benefits.description: Use our heat-set insert tools to add threaded inserts to your prints for stronger, more durable connections and assemblies.

benefits.title: Post Processing Tools
benefits.description: Finish your prints with our collection of post-processing tools for sanding, smoothing, and refining your 3D printed objects.

benefits.title: Community Materials
benefits.description: Access a shared stock of filament and other materials, making it easy and affordable to experiment with different types and colors.
